targets.outcome_quote: I collected data from 319 eligible participants (resulting in a final sample of 545). The H* effect did not replicate as there was significant relationship in the opposite direction between conception risk and voting preference using the coding scheme used by Navarrete et al, r(545)= -.112, p=.009.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Both initial and final pooled stages explicitly failed; the final association was in the opposite direction.
